# openwrt_system (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt system settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `conloglevel` (String) Console log level.
- `cronloglevel` (String) Cron log level.
- `hostname` (String) System hostname.
- `log_proto` (String) Log protocol: 'udp', 'tcp'.
- `log_size` (Number) System log size in KB.
- `ttylogin` (Boolean) Require TTY login.
- `urandom_seed` (Boolean) Seed urandom on boot.
- `zonename` (String) Timezone name (e.g., 'UTC').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: system.
